To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

mobile internet users do not perceive the mobile internet as a distinct medium and do not make a distinction between mobile and stationary internet use, but they do distinguish between extractive and immersive mobile internet use.

mobile internet users do not perceive the mobile internet as a new technology but rather as a new way of accessing the internet, and that they do not perceive a distinction in the act of ‘going online’ whether on a mobile device or a computer, even though there are clear distinctions in the way information is consumed.
the mobile internet is perceived as a natural extension of the desktop internet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which people conceptualize and understand the mobile internet, and the implications for future mobile media research and development.
the question of what people think about the mobile internet and how they use it.
understanding the role of the mobile internet in everyday life, and how people conceptualize the mobile internet in relation to other technologies and media.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Mobile Internet is not a separate media channel. It is a channel that is integrated into the users everyday lives.
the mobile Internet is not a new phenomenon, but a natural evolution in the way we use the internet, and is not a distinct entity from other internet access points, but a continuum of the internet.
mobile internet users do not see the act of going online as a significant step and they do not distinguish between mobile and stationary devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mobile internet is a new medium with its own unique features and affordances that are not yet fully explored.
the internet has become a part of our everyday life and is not limited to the PC anymore.
the mobile internet is not a distinct concept, but rather a way to access information on a mobile device that is used in a variety of situations and for a variety of purposes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mobile media are not just about the technology, but about how it is used and conceptualized.
mobile devices are not just a way to access the internet but are also used for a variety of other purposes.
the mobile internet is not a distinct entity, but is a component of the internet, with the same characteristics and functions, but with different affordances.
